file_roles.evidence: The whole diff is 'TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10' becoming 'TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 20'. The report states the cause lies elsewhere: 'This appears to be an underlying issue with yum (either a lock is not released, or multiple yum commands are ran in parallel), so to attempt to decrease its frequency, the agent's PackagesAnalyzer will increase the time it waits.'

rationale: The reported corruption happens in the RPM Berkeley DB ('db3 error(30974) from dbenv>failchk: DB_RUNRECOVERY'), which is outside this repository, and the reporter says so explicitly. The only changed file raises a timeout to make the symptom rarer, which the rubric defines as preventive, so this instance has no causal file at all. The symptom and log site are the same line the agent logs, 'PackagesAnalyzer.py:43 - Task timed out and will be killed'.
notes: A clean example of the reviewer's objection: the fix-modified file is where the timeout was raised, not where the defect lives. The defect is in yum/rpm and is not in the codebase at all, so no listed relation describes the symptom-to-cause link.
